page.layout: One block of running text (italic letter, ends with date line). Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rio alijsq; tibi vere fauetibus perfæpe & cre-bro tibi audire contigit: eaq; tibi cordi fore, ne-que te spem de te conceptam falsurum, plane confido. Itaque id vnum restat, vt te valere iubeā; rogemq;, vt me vicissim ames. id quod te facere existimabo, si ita gratum tibi hoc meum munusculum esse intelligam, vt calcaris quasi vice in studiis literarum profeque-dis apud te functum sit. Vale: Heidelbergæ, inter grauissimas occupationes, a. d. V. Kal. Sextil. Anno repræsentati Seruatoris M. D. LXVIII.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "alijsq;" in the first line (the mark after "aliys" may be j or y) and "eaq;" (the mark after q looks like a figure 3, possibly -que). Line 1 begins with a fragment ("rio") carried over from the previous page. The date line "Sextil. Anno repræsentati Seruatoris M. D. LXVIII." is set apart and was transcribed as a paragraph, not a heading. The text is italic throughout, apart from the date line, which is roman.
